papers.abstract_original: This paper studies estimation of causal effects in a panel data setting. We introduce a new estimator, the Triply Robust Panel (TROP) estimator, that combines (i)$$ (i) $$ a flexible model for the potential outcomes based on a low‐rank factor structure on top of a two‐way‐fixed effect specification, with (ii)$$ (ii) $$ unit weights intended to upweight units similar to the treated units and (iii)$$ (iii) $$ time weights intended to upweight time periods close to the treated time periods. We study the performance of the estimator in a set of simulations designed to closely match several commonly studied real data sets. We find that there is substantial variation in the performance of the estimators across the settings considered. The proposed estimator outperforms Two‐Way‐Fixed‐Effect (TWFE) or Difference‐In‐Differences (DID), Synthetic Control (SC), Matrix Completion (MC) and Synthetic‐Difference‐In‐Differences (SDID) estimators. We investigate what features of the data generating process lead to this superior performance and assess the relative importance of the three components of the proposed estimator. We have two recommendations. Our preferred strategy is that researchers use simulations closely matched to the data they are interested in, along the lines discussed in this paper, to investigate which estimators work well in their particular setting. A simpler approach is to use more robust estimators such as SDID or the new TROP estimator, which we find to substantially outperform TWFE/DID estimators in many empirically relevant settings.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文研究面板数据情形下的因果效应估计。我们引入一个新的估计量——三重稳健面板（TROP）估计量，它结合了：(i) 基于双向固定效应设定之上的低秩因子结构的潜在结果灵活模型，(ii) 旨在对与处理单元相似的单元赋予更高权重的单元权重，以及 (iii) 旨在对与处理时期接近的时期赋予更高权重的时间权重。我们在一组旨在与若干常用真实数据集密切匹配的模拟中研究了该估计量的表现。我们发现，在所考虑的各个设定中，估计量的表现存在相当大的差异。所提出的估计量优于双向固定效应（TWFE）或双重差分（DID）、合成控制（SC）、矩阵补全（MC）以及合成双重差分（SDID）估计量。我们研究了数据生成过程的哪些特征导致了这种更优表现，并评估了所提出估计量三个组成部分的相对重要性。我们有两项建议。我们偏好的策略是，研究人员按照本文所讨论的思路，使用与其感兴趣的数据密切匹配的模拟，来考察哪些估计量在其特定设定中表现良好。一个更简单的方法是使用更稳健的估计量，如SDID或新的TROP估计量，我们发现后者在许多具有实证相关性的设定中大幅优于TWFE/DID估计量。

papers.abstract_original: I provide a precision‐sampler‐based replication of the multivariate unobserved component stochastic volatility outlier‐adjusted model of Stock and Watson (2016) applied to inflation in the United States and the Euro Area (EA). I find a substantial post‐2020 increase in trend inflation for both the United States and the EA, and estimate end‐2024 trend inflation at 2.3 and 2.0 percent, respectively.
papers.abstract_zh: 我基于精确采样器，对Stock和Watson（2016）的多变量不可观测成分随机波动率异常值调整模型进行了复现，并将其应用于美国和欧元区（EA）的通胀。我发现，美国和欧元区的趋势通胀在2020年之后均出现大幅上升，并估计2024年底两者的趋势通胀分别为2.3%和2.0%。

papers.abstract_original: This paper studies heterogeneous mixed‐frequency panel data models, focusing on linear specifications that allow heterogeneity in both aggregation weights and slope coefficients. To address potential correlations between the heterogeneity and the covariates, we first show that, under additional normalization conditions, the mean‐group estimator delivers consistent and asymptotically normal slope estimates but biased weights estimators. As an alternative, we propose a correlated random effects estimator using a generalized Mundlak specification. We further discuss the implementation of these two estimators when covariates are observed at substantially higher sampling frequencies. Monte Carlo simulations are conducted to assess their finite‐sample properties. As an empirical illustration, we revisit the impact of temperature fluctuations on economic growth using the proposed framework.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文研究异质性混合频率面板数据模型，重点关注允许聚合权重和斜率系数均存在异质性的线性设定。为处理异质性与协变量之间可能存在的相关性，我们首先证明，在附加归一化条件下，均值组估计量能给出斜率的一致且渐近正态估计，但权重估计量有偏。作为替代方案，我们提出使用广义Mundlak设定的相关随机效应估计量。我们进一步讨论了当协变量以显著更高的抽样频率观测时这两种估计量的实现。我们进行蒙特卡洛模拟以评估其有限样本性质。作为实证示例，我们使用所提出的框架重新考察温度波动对经济增长的影响。

papers.abstract_original: Peer influence on effort devoted to some activity is often studied when effort is unobserved, and the researcher instead observes an outcome that combines effort with other shocks. For instance, in education, achievement measures such as GPA reflect both effort and idiosyncratic GPA shocks. We propose an alternative approach that circumvents this approximation. Our framework distinguishes unobserved shocks to GPA that do not affect effort from preference shocks that do affect effort levels. We show that peer effects estimates obtained using our approach can differ significantly from classical estimates (where effort is approximated) if the network includes isolated students. Applying our approach to data on high school students in the United States, we find that peer effect estimates relying on GPA as a proxy for effort are 40% lower than those obtained using our approach.
papers.abstract_zh: 当努力不可观测时，关于同伴对某项活动投入努力的影响的研究往往转而观测一个将努力与其他冲击结合在一起的产出。例如，在教育领域，GPA等成绩指标既反映努力，也反映特异性的GPA冲击。我们提出一种规避这一近似处理的方法。我们的框架区分了不影响努力的GPA不可观测冲击与影响努力水平的偏好冲击。我们表明，如果网络中包含孤立学生，使用我们的方法得到的同伴效应估计可能与经典估计（其中努力被近似处理）存在显著差异。将我们的方法应用于美国高中生的数据，我们发现，依赖GPA作为努力代理变量的同伴效应估计比使用我们的方法得到的估计低40%。

papers.abstract_original: We propose a unified framework for interpreting and comparing a broad class of synthetic control (SC) methods. Our framework is built on an analysis of a mean‐squared prediction error (MSPE) bound for the counterfactual predicted by a generic SC method, without imposing a specific outcome model. Using this framework, we develop a generalized SC method that provides a more comprehensive regularization of the MSPE bound than several existing SC methods. Through simulation studies and placebo analyses, we demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach in predicting the counterfactual.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个统一框架，用于解释和比较一大类合成控制（SC）方法。我们的框架基于对通用SC方法所预测反事实的均方预测误差（MSPE）界的分析，且不施加特定的结果模型。利用这一框架，我们开发了一种广义SC方法，相较于若干现有SC方法，该方法对MSPE界提供了更全面的正则化。通过模拟研究和安慰剂分析，我们证明了所提方法在预测反事实方面的有效性。

papers.abstract_original: We build on Modestino et al., who analysed “opportunistic upskilling” during the 2007 recession in the US, by extending their approach to European labour markets following recent economic shocks. Using a comprehensive dataset of online job postings (2019–2023) and an instrumental variable approach leveraging Ukrainian refugee inflows, we find that increases in labour supply have a significant positive effect on both education and experience requirements. Our findings reinforce the idea that employers opportunistically upskill labour demand in different but challenging macroeconomic contexts. The identification of such patterns, however, depends on the presence of a plausibly exogenous shock to labour markets.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们以Modestino等人的研究为基础，他们分析了2007年经济衰退期间美国出现的“机会性技能升级”，我们将他们的方法扩展到近期经济冲击之后的欧洲劳动力市场。我们使用2019—2023年在线招聘岗位的综合数据集，并采用利用乌克兰难民流入的工具变量方法，发现劳动力供给的增加对教育要求和经验要求均有显著的正向影响。我们的发现强化了这一观点：雇主会在不同但充满挑战的宏观经济环境中机会性地提升劳动力需求的技能要求。然而，对此类模式的识别取决于劳动力市场是否存在一个看似外生的冲击。

papers.abstract_original: We estimate the first time‐varying, county‐level index of housing supply elasticities across the United States, using a structural vector autoregression model with sign restrictions to identify the effect of a positive demand shock. This index reveals four features of the supply curve in different local housing markets. First, supply elasticities are low, on average, generating faster price growth than housing unit growth for most of the country. Second, there is significant variation in elasticities across counties, both urban and rural. Third, elasticities have declined in more counties than they have risen over time, particularly in large urban markets. Fourth, these new estimates predict housing quantity growth better than previous models in the literature.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们使用带有符号限制的结构向量自回归模型来识别正向需求冲击的影响，首次估计了美国各县层面随时间变化的住房供给弹性指数。该指数揭示了不同地方住房市场中供给曲线的四个特征。第一，平均而言供给弹性较低，导致美国大部分地区的价格增长快于住房单元数量增长。第二，无论是城市还是农村，各县之间的弹性存在显著差异。第三，随着时间推移，弹性下降的县多于弹性上升的县，尤其是在大型城市市场。第四，与文献中以往的模型相比，这些新估计能更好地预测住房数量增长。

papers.abstract_original: We analyse fiscal policy in resource‐rich economies using a novel Bayesian regime‐switching panel model. The identified regimes capture pro‐ or countercyclical fiscal behaviour by allowing regime‐specific shifts in the average fiscal stance, while the switches between the regimes have the interpretation of changes in fiscal policy. Applying the model to a panel of sixteen oil‐producing economies, we show that fiscal policy has alternated between a procyclical and countercyclical regime multiple times over the sample. Furthermore, we find that fiscal policy is more volatile in the procyclical regime and that the probability of being in the procyclical regime is higher for OPEC countries than for non‐OPEC countries. We also show that following either an increase or decrease in oil revenues, the growth in government expenditures is mostly increasing, suggesting an upward bias in expenditures in oil‐producing countries. These are new findings in the literature.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们使用一种新颖的贝叶斯制度转换面板模型分析资源丰富型经济体中的财政政策。所识别出的制度通过允许平均财政立场的制度特定变动来刻画顺周期或逆周期的财政行为，而制度之间的转换则具有财政政策变化的解释。将该模型应用于由十六个石油生产经济体组成的面板，我们表明财政政策在样本期内多次在顺周期制度与逆周期制度之间交替。此外，我们发现财政政策在顺周期制度下波动更大，并且OPEC国家处于顺周期制度的概率高于非OPEC国家。我们还表明，在石油收入增加或减少之后，政府支出的增长大多呈上升态势，这表明石油生产国的支出存在上行偏向。这些是文献中的新发现。

papers.abstract_original: Lévy processes are widely used in financial modeling due to their ability to capture discontinuities and heavy tails, which are common in high‐frequency asset return data. However, parameter estimation remains a challenge when associated likelihoods are unavailable or costly to compute. We propose a fast and accurate method for Lévy parameter estimation using the neural Bayes estimation (NBE) framework—a simulation‐based, likelihood‐free approach that leverages permutation‐invariant neural networks to approximate Bayes estimators. We contribute new theoretical results, showing that NBE results in consistent estimators whose risk converges to that of the Bayes estimator under mild conditions. Moreover, through extensive simulations across several Lévy models, we show that NBE outperforms traditional methods in both accuracy and runtime, while also enabling two complementary approaches to uncertainty quantification. We illustrate our approach on a challenging high‐frequency cryptocurrency return dataset, where the method captures evolving parameter dynamics and delivers reliable and interpretable inference at a fraction of the computational cost of traditional methods. We investigate nearly a decade of high‐frequency Bitcoin returns, requiring less than one minute to estimate parameters under the proposed approach.
papers.abstract_zh: Lévy过程因能够刻画高频资产收益数据中常见的不连续性和厚尾特征，而被广泛应用于金融建模。然而，当相关似然不可得或计算成本高昂时，参数估计仍然是一项挑战。我们提出了一种利用神经贝叶斯估计（NBE）框架进行Lévy参数估计的快速且准确的方法——该框架是一种基于模拟、无需似然的方法，利用置换不变神经网络来近似贝叶斯估计量。我们贡献了新的理论结果，表明在温和条件下，NBE可得到相合估计量，其风险收敛于贝叶斯估计量的风险。此外，通过在若干Lévy模型上进行大量模拟，我们表明NBE在准确性和运行时间上均优于传统方法，同时还提供了两种互补的不确定性量化方法。我们在一个具有挑战性的高频加密货币收益数据集上展示了我们的方法，该方法能够捕捉不断演化的参数动态，并以传统方法计算成本的一小部分提供可靠且可解释的推断。我们研究了近十年的高频比特币收益，在所提方法下估计参数所需时间不到一分钟。

papers.abstract_original: This study proposes specification tests for interference structure in causal inference with spillovers. We focus on experimental settings in which the treatment assignment mechanism is known. To test whether a given exposure mapping adequately summarizes the true interference structure, we develop conditional randomization tests by utilizing the hierarchical relationship between the null and alternative exposure mappings. When there are multiple candidate exposure mappings of interest, we propose a sequential specification testing procedure that controls the false discovery rate. Through extensive simulation exercises, we demonstrate that our tests have desirable size properties and satisfactory power. To illustrate the proposed methods, we revisit two existing social network experiments: One on farmers' insurance adoption and another on anti‐conflict education programs.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究提出用于溢出效应下因果推断中干扰结构设定的检验。我们聚焦于处理分配机制已知的实验设定。为检验给定的暴露映射是否充分概括了真实的干扰结构，我们利用原假设与备择暴露映射之间的层级关系，构建了条件随机化检验。当存在多个感兴趣的候选暴露映射时，我们提出一种控制错误发现率的序贯设定检验程序。通过大量模拟实验，我们证明所提出的检验具有理想的水平性质和令人满意的功效。为说明所提方法，我们重新分析了两个已有的社会网络实验：一个关于农民保险采纳，另一个关于反冲突教育项目。

papers.abstract_original: This paper proposes a simple smooth specification test for the propensity score in the spirit of Neyman (1937). We derive a particular restriction on the propensity score and construct the specification test based on it. Using the density‐weighting method, we transform the original specification testing problem into a test of the joint significance of the generalized Fourier coefficients. We propose a novel projection method to eliminate the parameter estimation effect arising from estimating unknown nuisance parameters. The proposed test is shown to follow a standard χ2$$ {\chi}^2 $$ distribution under the null hypothesis and to possess nontrivial asymptotic power against local alternatives that converge to the null at the parametric rate n−1/2$$ {n}^{-1/2} $$, where n$$ n $$ is the sample size. To enhance the practical applicability of the procedure, we further introduce a data‐driven selection method for determining the testing order, enabling automatic selection based on the observed data. Compared to existing methods, our test does not suffer from the “curse of dimensionality” faced by Shaikh et al. (2009); at the same time, our test is both asymptotically pivotal and more computationally efficient than that of Sant'Anna and Song (2019). Extensive simulations demonstrate that the proposed test yields satisfactory empirical size and power. Compared with previous tests, our test exhibits comparable overall performance and delivers clear improvements in some cases, especially for high‐frequency alternatives. Two empirical applications further illustrate the practical applicability of our proposal, examining propensity score specifications in the Soviet 156 Program and the US Job Corps Program.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文借鉴Neyman（1937）的思想，提出了一种简单的倾向得分平滑设定检验。我们推导出对倾向得分的一项特定约束，并据此构建设定检验。利用密度加权方法，我们将原始的设定检验问题转化为对广义傅里叶系数联合显著性的检验。我们提出了一种新颖的投影方法，以消除由估计未知干扰参数所引起的参数估计效应。所提出的检验在原假设下服从标准χ2$$ {\chi}^2 $$分布，并且对以参数速率n−1/2$$ {n}^{-1/2} $$收敛于原假设的局部备择假设具有非平凡的渐近功效，其中n$$ n $$为样本量。为增强该方法的实际适用性，我们进一步引入了一种数据驱动的选择方法来确定检验阶数，从而能够基于观测数据自动选择。与现有方法相比，我们的检验不受Shaikh等（2009）所面临的“维数灾难”的影响；同时，我们的检验既是渐近枢轴的，又比Sant'Anna和Song（2019）的检验在计算上更高效。大量模拟表明，所提出的检验具有令人满意的经验水平和功效。与以往的检验相比，我们的检验表现出相当的整体性能，并在某些情形下——尤其是对高频备择假设——有明显改进。两个实证应用进一步说明了我们提议的实际适用性，分别考察了苏联156计划和美国Job Corps计划中的倾向得分设定。

papers.abstract_original: How do labor market institutions shape the transmission of government spending shocks and macroeconomic volatility? We develop a theoretical model in which labor market institutions affect fiscal transmission through their effect on wage rigidity, job separation, and matching frictions. We estimate an interacted panel vector autoregressive model for 16 OECD economies and study how macroeconomic responses to government spending shocks vary with institutional labor market characteristics. In line with our theoretical predictions, we show that institutions that stabilize employment and wages tend to reduce output volatility and attenuate the response of output and employment to government spending shocks.
papers.abstract_zh: 劳动力市场制度如何塑造政府支出冲击的传导与宏观经济波动？我们构建了一个理论模型，其中劳动力市场制度通过其对工资刚性、工作分离和匹配摩擦的影响来影响财政传导。我们为16个OECD经济体估计了一个交互面板向量自回归模型，并研究宏观经济对政府支出冲击的响应如何随制度性劳动力市场特征而变化。与我们的理论预测一致，我们表明，稳定就业和工资的制度往往会降低产出波动，并减弱产出和就业对政府支出冲击的响应。

papers.abstract_original: This paper explores the existence of network externalities in link formation games of incomplete information. It extends the structural estimation method in Leung (2015) to games where links are undirected and proposals are only partially observed. We provide an econometric characterization of the proposed two‐step estimator and document its performance through a simulation exercise. When the estimation method is applied to data on risk‐sharing arrangements in a Tanzanian village, results indicate that indirect connections matter.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文探讨不完全信息连接形成博弈中网络外部性的存在性。它将Leung（2015）的结构估计方法扩展到连接为无向且提议仅被部分观测的博弈。我们给出了所提出的两步估计量的计量经济学刻画，并通过模拟实验记录了其表现。当将该估计方法应用于坦桑尼亚某村庄的风险分担安排数据时，结果表明间接联系具有影响。

papers.abstract_original: While existing work shows COVID‐19 stay‐at‐home (SAH) policies decreased mobility on average, we lack evidence regarding heterogeneity in policy effectiveness across US counties. To uncover potential heterogeneity, we implement a novel two‐stage approach. First, we employ recent advances in synthetic control estimation and inference to obtain and bound both time‐average and county‐specific treatment effects. Next, we use a local linear forest to explain observed heterogeneity using county‐level predictors. This procedure reveals substantial variation in policy effectiveness and identifies predictors of policy effectiveness which can be used to target future SAH policies.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管现有研究表明COVID-19居家令（SAH）政策平均而言减少了流动性，但我们缺乏关于政策有效性在美国各县之间异质性的证据。为揭示潜在的异质性，我们采用了一种新颖的两阶段方法。首先，我们运用合成控制估计与推断的最新进展，获得并界定时间平均处理效应和县特定处理效应。其次，我们使用局部线性森林，利用县级预测变量来解释观察到的异质性。该程序揭示了政策有效性的显著差异，并识别出可用于为未来居家令政策提供靶向依据的政策有效性预测变量。

papers.abstract_original: We propose a method to identify the anticipated components of macroeconomic shocks in a structural VAR. We include empirical forecasts about each time series in the VAR. This introduces enough linear restrictions to identify every structural shock and to further decompose each one into “news” and “surprise” shocks. We estimate a VAR on U.S. time series using forecast data from the SPF, CBO, Federal Reserve, and asset prices. Unanticipated fiscal stimulus and monetary policy shocks have typical effects that match existing evidence. In our news‐surprise decomposition, we find that news drives around one quarter of U.S. business cycle volatility. News explains a larger share of the variance due to fiscal shocks than for monetary policy shocks. Finally, we use the news structure of the shocks to estimate counterfactual policy rules, and compare the ability of fiscal and monetary policy to moderate output and inflation. We find that coordinated fiscal and monetary policy are substantially more effective than either individually.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种在结构向量自回归（VAR）中识别宏观经济冲击的预期成分的方法。我们将关于VAR中每个时间序列的经验预测纳入模型。这引入了足够的线性约束，以识别每一个结构冲击，并进一步将每个冲击分解为“新闻”冲击和“意外”冲击。我们使用来自SPF、CBO、美联储和资产价格的预测数据，对美国时间序列估计了一个VAR。未预期的财政刺激和货币政策冲击具有与现有证据相符的典型效应。在我们的新闻—意外分解中，我们发现新闻驱动了约四分之一的美国商业周期波动。与货币政策冲击相比，新闻解释了财政冲击所致方差中更大的份额。最后，我们利用冲击的新闻结构来估计反事实政策规则，并比较财政政策和货币政策缓和产出与通胀的能力。我们发现，协调的财政政策与货币政策比二者各自单独实施要有效得多。

papers.abstract_original: We estimate the causal effects of macroprudential policies on the entire distribution of GDP growth for advanced European economies using a narrative‐identification strategy in a quantile‐regression framework. While macroprudential policy has near‐zero effects on the center of the GDP‐growth distribution, tighter policy brings benefits by reducing the variance of future growth, significantly boosting the left tail while simultaneously reducing the right. Assessing a range of channels through which these effects materialize, we find that macroprudential policy particularly operates through ‘credit‐at‐risk’: it reduces the right tail of future credit growth, dampening booms, in turn reducing the likelihood of extreme GDP‐growth outturns.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们采用分位数回归框架中的叙事识别策略，估计宏观审慎政策对发达欧洲经济体GDP增长率整个分布的因果效应。虽然宏观审慎政策对GDP增长分布的中心几乎无影响，但收紧政策通过降低未来增长的方差带来益处，显著提升左尾，同时降低右尾。在评估这些效应得以实现的一系列渠道后，我们发现宏观审慎政策尤其通过“风险中的信贷”发挥作用：它降低未来信贷增长的右尾，抑制繁荣，进而降低GDP增长出现极端结果的可能性。

papers.abstract_original: We introduce EA‐MD‐QD, a new publicly available dataset comprising 1136 macroeconomic time series for the euro area (EA) and its ten largest member countries observed at monthly or quarterly frequency. Since January 2024, EA‐MD‐QD has been updated monthly and continuously revised, providing a valuable resource for policy analysis in the EA. Using EA‐MD‐QD, we study country‐specific impulse responses to an EA‐wide monetary policy shock. Results reveal moderate yet significant cross‐country heterogeneity, with differences between so‐called core countries, such as France and Germany, and peripheral countries, such as Italy and Spain, in their price and interest rate responses, together with meaningful differences in real activity, while stock price responses are relatively homogeneous. Evidence points to homeownership and saving behavior as potential drivers of the observed cross‐country differences.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们推出EA‐MD‐QD，这是一个新的公开可用数据集，包含欧元区（EA）及其十个最大成员国的1136个宏观经济时间序列，观测频率为月度或季度。自2024年1月起，EA‐MD‐QD每月更新并持续修订，为欧元区的政策分析提供了宝贵资源。利用EA‐MD‐QD，我们研究了各国对欧元区范围货币政策冲击的特定脉冲响应。结果揭示了温和但显著的跨国异质性：所谓核心国家（如法国和德国）与外围国家（如意大利和西班牙）在价格和利率响应上存在差异，实际活动也有显著差异，而股票价格响应则相对同质。证据表明，住房所有权和储蓄行为是观察到的跨国差异的潜在驱动因素。

papers.abstract_original: Despite its conceptual appeal, the autoregressive inverse‐Wishart (AIW) multivariate stochastic volatility model has been hindered by inefficient sampling methods. The existing samplers for the latent covariance matrix severely suffer from the curse of dimensionality and only work when the dimension is very low. In this paper, we introduce a new proposal for the latent covariance matrix in the AIW model, which demonstrates far better scalability. We introduce different extensions to the basic AIW model that capture various stylized volatility features. We further fit the AIW model into a factor structure and provide an a posteriori identification procedure without introducing order dependence. When evaluated using real datasets ranging from 10 assets to 1000 assets, the new AIW‐based models, whether the standalone versions or the factor versions, are especially suited for multivariate volatility modeling in a wide range of dimensions.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管自回归逆Wishart（AIW）多元随机波动率模型在概念上具有吸引力，但其一直受制于低效的抽样方法。现有的潜在协方差矩阵抽样器严重受制于维数灾难，仅在维度非常低时才有效。本文针对AIW模型中的潜在协方差矩阵提出了一种新的提议分布，其可扩展性显著更优。我们引入了基本AIW模型的多种扩展，以刻画各种典型化的波动率特征。我们进一步将AIW模型纳入因子结构，并提供了一种不引入顺序依赖的事后识别程序。在使用从10项资产到1000项资产的真实数据集进行评估时，基于AIW的新模型，无论是独立版本还是因子版本，都特别适合广泛维度范围内的多元波动率建模。

papers.abstract_original: This paper examines intergenerational mobility in China and Russia during their transitions from central planning to market systems. We consider mobility as movement, measured as changes in status between parents and children. We provide estimates of two key mobility measures: overall mobility, which captures total intergenerational movement including the effects of changing class distributions across generations, and steady‐state mobility, which captures the long‐run mobility intrinsic to the intergenerational process once the class distribution has stabilized. We further decompose overall mobility into structural and exchange components. We find that China exhibits more overall educational mobility than Russia, mostly due to greater structural mobility, while Russia exhibits greater steady‐state educational mobility. Overall and steady‐state occupational mobility are similar in China and Russia. Comparing these results to the US, we find that educational steady‐state mobility is substantially lower in China than in both Russia and the US, with Russia being the most mobile, but occupational steady‐state mobility is comparable across all three countries.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文考察中国和俄罗斯在从中央计划向市场体系转型期间的代际流动。我们将流动视为移动，以父母与子女之间的地位变化来衡量。我们提供了两项关键流动指标的估计：总体流动，它捕捉包括各代之间阶层分布变化影响在内的全部代际移动；稳态流动，它捕捉一旦阶层分布稳定后内在于代际过程的长期流动。我们进一步将总体流动分解为结构成分和交换成分。我们发现，中国在总体上表现出比俄罗斯更高的教育流动，这主要归因于更大的结构流动，而俄罗斯表现出更高的稳态教育流动。中国和俄罗斯的总体职业流动与稳态职业流动相似。将这些结果与美国比较，我们发现中国的教育稳态流动显著低于俄罗斯和美国，其中俄罗斯的流动性最高，但三国的职业稳态流动相当。

papers.abstract_original: Wage markup shocks, an important driver of business cycles, are hard to pin down. We quantify the importance of exogenous variation in wage bargaining power, one source of those shocks, from German minimum wage introduction episodes and strikes. This disciplines the impulse responses of unemployment and output, and sharpens inference for other variables, which behave consistently with predictions from search‐and‐matching models. We find that wage bargaining shocks meaningfully contribute to aggregate fluctuations in unemployment and inflation, exhibit substantial pass‐through to prices, and imply plausible dynamics for the vacancy rate, firms' profits, and the labor share.
papers.abstract_zh: 工资加成冲击是经济周期的重要驱动因素，却难以准确识别。我们利用德国最低工资引入事件和罢工，量化了工资谈判能力外生变化的重要性，而工资谈判能力是此类冲击的来源之一。这约束了失业和产出的脉冲响应，并锐化了其他变量的推断，这些变量的表现与搜寻—匹配模型的预测一致。我们发现，工资谈判冲击对失业和通胀的总量波动有实质性贡献，对价格具有显著的传导效应，并对空缺率、企业利润和劳动份额意味着合理的动态。

papers.abstract_original: We estimate average equivalised consumption measures across 370 local authority districts in Great Britain, using small‐area estimation methods that combine information from a household budget survey, a much larger survey of local demographics and employment, and area‐level information on bank account outflows and energy consumption. We show that including bank account data substantially improves our estimates, showing that these and other financial footprints data can play an important role in measuring local consumption and hence living standards. We also compare consumption measures that correspond to welfare under different assumptions about mobility and the capitalisation of local amenities into house prices, as well as traditional local income measures, and show that the rankings of local authorities are sensitive to the choice of measure.

papers.abstract_original: We estimate the causal effects of the introduction of the minimum wage in Germany on the distributions of hourly wages, monthly earnings, and hours worked, combining rich large‐scale data sources. We compare linear and non‐linear versions of distribution regression difference‐in‐differences (DR‐DiD) and also estimate bivariate DR‐DiD. We show that the introduction of the minimum wage in 2015 led to shifts in low hourly wages around the minimum wage threshold including spillover effects up to 50%–70% above. We present evidence for working hours effects in different parts of the hours distribution, though the magnitudes are small. The minimum wage explains a sizeable share of the recent fall in wage and earnings inequality. We show that groups that were later more strongly affected by the minimum wage already experienced higher wage growth before the introduction, leading to an overestimation of minimum wage effects if not accounted for.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们结合丰富的大规模数据来源，估计德国引入最低工资对小时工资、月收入和工时分布的因果效应。我们比较分布回归双重差分法（DR-DiD）的线性与非线性版本，并估计双变量DR-DiD。我们表明，2015年引入最低工资导致最低工资门槛附近低小时工资发生变动，并包括最高达门槛以上50%–70%的溢出效应。我们提供了工时分布不同部分存在工时效应的证据，尽管幅度较小。最低工资解释了近期工资和收入不平等下降的相当大一部分。我们表明，后来受最低工资影响更强的群体在引入之前就已经经历了更高的工资增长，若不加以考虑，会导致对最低工资效应的高估。

papers.abstract_original: I propose a new imputation estimator for missing covariate values in nonlinear models. The estimator provides efficiency gains relative to just using the complete cases, and is consistent for any model that falls under M‐estimation. This is unlike the commonly used dummy variable method and regression imputation, which I show to be generally inconsistent in nonlinear models. The proposed estimator is straightforward to implement, and relies only on the commonly used assumptions on missingness. To test these assumptions, I provide a novel and simple variable addition test. I show how the framework applies to nonlinear models for fractional and nonnegative responses.
papers.abstract_zh: 我提出了一种用于非线性模型中缺失协变量值的新插补估计量。相对于仅使用完整案例，该估计量能带来效率提升，并且对于任何属于M估计的模型都是一致的。这与常用的虚拟变量方法和回归插补不同，我证明后者在非线性模型中通常是不一致的。所提出的估计量易于实施，且仅依赖于关于缺失性的常用假设。为检验这些假设，我提供了一种新颖而简单的变量添加检验。我展示了该框架如何适用于分数响应和非负响应的非线性模型。

papers.abstract_original: Browning et al. (2013) model collective‐household economies of scale in goods consumption by having each good be partly shared, instead of each good being public or private. papers.abstract_original: This article partially identifies population treatment effects in observational data under both non‐random treatment assignment and sample selection. Bounds are provided for both average and quantile population treatment effects, combining assumptions for the selected and the non‐selected subsamples. We show how different assumptions help narrow identification regions, and we illustrate our methods by partially identifying the effect of maternal education on the 2015 PISA math test scores in Brazil. papers.abstract_original: The value of lawyers to their clients is notoriously difficult to estimate because of endogeneity. We utilize modifications to the collateral source (CS) rule that require reducing trial awards by the amount of payments from first‐party insurance as an instrument for hiring a lawyer. The problem with our instrument is that modifications to the CS rule have a direct effect on recovery and, hence, violate the exclusion restriction required for a valid instrument. We develop a new identification and estimation method that uses CS rule changes as an invalid instrument and bounds the impact of lawyers. We find that our estimated impact's upper and lower bounds are lower than estimates that do not correct for endogeneity. Our estimates of the impact of lawyers on total payment are consistently negative, although not precise enough to claim statistical significance. The upper bound of the effect of hiring a lawyer on total payment received is negative after fees in our preferred specification. This suggests that even in the most optimistic scenario, lawyers appear to reduce total recovery.
papers.abstract_zh: 由于内生性，律师对其客户的价值极难估计。我们利用对担保来源（CS）规则的修改——该修改要求按第一方保险赔付金额扣减审判赔偿金——作为雇佣律师的工具变量。我们工具变量的问题在于，对CS规则的修改对赔偿金额有直接影响，因而违反了有效工具变量所需的排除性限制。我们开发了一种新的识别与估计方法，将CS规则变更用作无效工具变量，并对律师的影响进行界定。我们发现，所估计影响的上界和下界均低于未对内生性进行校正的估计值。我们对律师对总赔付影响的估计始终为负，尽管精度不足以声称具有统计显著性。在我们偏好的设定中，雇佣律师对所得总赔付影响的上界在扣除费用后为负。这表明，即使在最乐观的情形下，律师似乎也会减少总赔偿额。

papers.abstract_original: This paper replicates and extends the evidence on the lifetime effects of school starting age on earnings by Fredriksson and Öckert (2014) for Sweden. Using German data for individuals born between 1945 and 1965, we examine a more rigid system of ability tracking in secondary education, a potential driver of long‐term effects. We confirm negligible effects of later school entry for men and positive effects for women. These gender differences arise despite similar effects on educational attainment. By unfolding the gender gaps over the lifecycle, assessing fertility decisions, and maternal employment around the first birth, we show that childbirth postponement and increased labor market attachment after the first birth seem to be plausible mechanisms.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文复现并扩展了Fredriksson和Öckert（2014）关于瑞典入学年龄对一生收入影响的证据。我们使用1945年至1965年出生的德国个体数据，考察了中等教育中更为严格的能力分轨制度——长期效应的一个潜在驱动因素。我们证实，较晚入学对男性的影响可忽略不计，对女性则有正向影响。尽管对教育获得的影响相似，这些性别差异依然存在。通过展开整个生命周期中的性别差距、评估生育决策以及首次生育前后的母亲就业情况，我们表明，推迟生育以及首次生育后增强劳动力市场依附似乎是合理的机制。

papers.abstract_original: We investigate how school closures affect educational outcomes through parental responses. Using quasi‐experimental variation in school‐level closure days and linked administrative‐survey data, we find that 10 additional closure days raise private tutoring expenditure by 4.1% and within‐school test‐score dispersion by 25%; over the average 53‐day closure, low‐income students lose 0.09 SD. To quantify substitution between schooling and parental investment and evaluate compensatory policy, we estimate a tournament model in which schooling and tutoring jointly produce test scores. Tutoring substitutes for in‐person days, burdening low‐income households disproportionately. Counterfactuals show a means‐tested voucher fully offsets the resulting rise in inequality.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究学校停课如何通过家长反应影响教育结果。利用学校层面停课天数的准实验变异以及关联的行政—调查数据，我们发现，额外增加10个停课日会使私人辅导支出提高4.1%，使校内考试成绩离散度提高25%；在平均53天的停课期间，低收入学生损失0.09个标准差。为量化学校教育与家长投资之间的替代关系并评估补偿性政策，我们估计了一个锦标赛模型，其中学校教育与辅导共同产生考试成绩。辅导替代面对面在校天数，给低收入家庭带来不成比例的负担。反事实模拟显示，一项经济状况调查的辅导券完全抵消了由此产生的不平等上升。
